name: Purdue University
description: Purdue University is a public research university in West Lafayette, Indiana, founded in 1869 as Indiana's land-grant university. It is known for engineering, aeronautics, computer science and agriculture.
whyIncluded: Purdue University is among the 10 universities in the United States most chosen by international students (12,874 international students in 2024-25, per IIE Open Doors), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: Purdue's official 2026-27 cost estimate for international undergraduates at West Lafayette: a combined housing-and-food allowance (split here into rent and food), transportation, and miscellaneous plus books, over a 9-month academic year.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A (housing and food combined). Purdue Bursar 'Undergraduate Tuition and Fees 2026-2027', Fall/Spring flat rate (8+ credit hours), 'Academic Year Cost' column, International: Housing/Food 16,734 (footnote: 'Estimated On-Campus Housing/Food is a billed expense estimated at $16,734 for the academic year; Off-Campus Housing/Food is not a billed expense and is estimated at $16,734'), Books/Course Materials/Supplies/Equipment 1,090, Transportation 570, Miscellaneous/Federal Student Loan Fees 2,200 ('costs vary; loan fees apply if the student is receiving federal loans'). The page does not state months; 9 recorded for the fall+spring academic year. Housing/Food is not split by the page, so 16,734 was divided using the US housing:food share ratio .63:.20 -> housing 12,701.11 / 9 = 1,411.23, food 4,032.89 / 9 = 448.10; transport = 570 / 9 = 63.33; personal = (2,200 misc + 1,090 books) / 9 = 365.56. Tuition and fees (international sub-total 32,104) excluded. The Division of Financial Aid COA page (purdue.edu/dfa/cost) describes the categories but gives no amounts; admissions.purdue.edu cost page was blocked ('requested URL was rejected').

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering (BSME)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international undergraduates at Purdue West Lafayette, including this programme's extra differential charge, plus student fees. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: Bursar's West Lafayette undergraduate table, international, 8+ credit hours flat rate, per semester x2: General Service $4,859 + Nonresident Tuition $9,401 + International Student Tuition $1,655 (2026-27 and 2025-26; $1,155 in 2024-25) = $31,830 a year ($30,830 in 2024-25). Other fees = Student Fitness & Wellness Fee $117 + Student Activity Fee $20 per semester x2 = $274 (same in all three years). No international one-time fee is listed. Purdue does not guarantee nonresident/international rates, so not cohort-locked. Differential general service for 'Computer Science/Data Science & Engineering UG': $4,050 a year in 2026-27, $2,050 in 2025-26, $2,050 in 2024-25 (per semester x2). Per the Board of Trustees' June 2025 tuition memo, the engineering and computer science/data science/AI differential rose by $1,000 a semester for nonresident and international undergraduates enrolling for the first time in fall 2026 or after ($1,025 -> $2,025 per semester); continuing students pay the old rate. The table's footnotes do not say whether First-Year Engineering students pay it, so the full differential is assumed for all four years. Students enter through First-Year Engineering before the Mechanical Engineering major.
